newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gov't slams auditor over dam report.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gov't slams auditor over dam report.

text.p: Argentine Energy Secretary Carlos Bastos hit back Monday at a report by the state auditing office criticizing the government's plans to sell off the giant Yacyreta hydroelectric dam.

In a report released last Tuesday, the auditing office said that the government would be better off paying a private operator a fee to operate the dam than tendering the rights to sell its energy for 30 years as it plans.
But Bastos said in a declaration distributed to the media that the auditor had made key mistakes in doing the financial sums to analyze the two alternatives.
He said the auditor failed to properly compute current interest rates, and the value of transmission lines and $906-million worth of works still to be finished at the dam.
"The error consists in focusing on the subject of Yacyret as if it were a financial operation. This same focus has been adopted by the opposition," Bastos said.
The state auditing office is a body nominated by Congress and controlled by the opposition Radical Party.
Bastos said that any change to plans to sell off Yacyret would also mean having to negotiate a new protocol with Paraguay, the joint-owner of the dam.

"The issue here is not a financial operation but how to efficiently complete Yacyret. So the auditor should take into special consideration that carrying out any other alternative would imply negotiating again with Paraguay while Yacyret continues to run up high operating costs," Bastos said.

But Bastos welcomed one part of the auditor's report, which valued Yacyret at around $2.65 billion, well down on previous estimates by groups hostile to privatization. The government values the dam, which has so far cost more than $8 billion, at $2.57 billion.

The government estimates that it would receive about $997.5 million for the dam, Bastos said. After several years of operation, the government would also charge the concessionaire a fee for the operation of the dam.
